evals.prompt: On the budget list page, add a small line under each budget card's title that shows how many items are planned for this month, like '12 items this month'. Show nothing when there are none.
evals.expected_output: The count and its wording are computed in the endpoint or view model (BudgetCardModel gets a formatted string or null), not in BudgetListPage.razor. The page renders it with MnlText only when present. A test in Menlo.Api.Tests/Ui checks the text appears and is absent at zero.

assertions.text: The '12 items this month' text (including pluralisation) is built in C# (endpoint, view model or a presentation helper), not in the .razor file
BudgetListPage.razor contains no arithmetic, pluralisation logic or number formatting for the new line
The line is rendered with a design-system component (MnlText) and no new CSS or inline style
The data comes through the existing handler/BudgetUi adapter or its DTO, not a new database query in the UI endpoint
A test under src/api/Menlo.Api.Tests/Ui requests /budgets and asserts the new text, including the none case

evals.prompt: Add a 'Rename budget note' style form: on the budget detail page I want an 'Add note' button that opens a panel with a single text field (max 200 characters, required). On save it should show a toast 'Note saved.' and the note should appear under the total. Assume a handler SaveBudgetNoteHandler already exists behind PUT /api/budgets/{id}/note.
evals.expected_output: A NoteFormPanel (MnlPanel) and NoteForm (form with hx-put, hx-target=this, hx-swap=outerHTML, novalidate) fragment; GET endpoint returning the panel via Render.Fragment, opened with hx-target MnlPanel.HostSelector; PUT endpoint that parses into a model with FormErrors, returns Render.Invalid (422) on validation failure, and HxResponse().Toast(...).ClosePanel().Raise(event).NoContent on success; the budget region listens for that event; CanEditBudget policy; tests for invalid and valid submits.

assertions.text: The form is opened as an MnlPanel fragment swapped into MnlPanel.HostSelector, not a new page or inline toggle
Required and max-length are validated on the server into FormErrors, and the form has novalidate
A validation failure returns Render.Invalid with the form alone (422), not the panel
Success returns 204 via HxResponse with Toast('Note saved.'), ClosePanel and a raised event, rather than returning updated page markup
The region showing the note reloads on the event (a UiEvents name used in BudgetRegion or an hx-trigger ... from:body)
The GET and PUT endpoints require CanEditBudget and the button is hidden for readers via a CanEdit model flag
No .razor file added has @inject, inline style, <script> or hx-on
Tests cover the invalid submit (422 with error text) and the valid submit (204 with the toast in HX-Trigger)

evals.prompt: Explain how Menlo's UI separates pages, components and utilities, and where state and behaviour go. Keep it short.
evals.expected_output: Pages and fragments are .razor files in Menlo.Api/Ui/<Feature> that take a view model; components are Mnl* in Menlo.Ui with no Menlo knowledge; utilities are pure static classes. State is an immutable view model already formatted; behaviour is the endpoint that calls handlers and builds the model; presentation is the .razor file. Page state lives in the URL.

assertions.text: Names pages, fragments (or partial page parts), components and utilities with where each lives
Says state is a view model that is already formatted
Says behaviour lives in the endpoint, which calls the same handlers as the JSON API
Mentions that page state (filters, selection, period) lives in the URL
Does not describe Angular, signals, services injected into components, or client-side state
